update: Shipped a new round of investigative tooling for the Gecko team — long-form storytelling now scrolls across narrative chapters with embedded archival evidence, and the editorial team can stage drafts without touching the live build.
title: Storytelling tooling, round two
body:
This was a cross-functional sprint with the Gecko editors and the dev team. The hard part wasn't the scrolling chapters — it was getting the staging workflow to feel natural for editors who were used to a CMS-only flow.

What we ended up with: a side-by-side preview that mirrors the production CSS, plus a one-click rollback if the new chapter breaks at any breakpoint. Small, but it changes how willing editors are to experiment.
